name: application-grids
title: Grids
description: Responsive grid layouts and grid systems for web applications with customizable columns and rows. Flexible grid components for dashboards, admin panels, and content organization.
useWhen: Responsive grid layouts and grid systems for web applications with customizable columns and rows. Flexible grid components for dashboards, admin panels, and content organization.
avoidWhen: Avoid grids when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Grids uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
